title: Old Neem Tree Protection Rules Display
title_te: పాత వేప చెట్ల రక్షణ నియమాల ప్రదర్శన
problem: Unknown people cut down 50-year-old shady neem trees on our village common land at night to sell the wood illegally.
idea: A tree identifier that recognises neem leaves and shows tree protection rules. Tap the leaf the camera sees to try it.

widgets.heading: 🎯 Try it: Which leaf is this?
widgets.intro: In my real project, Teachable Machine recognises the leaf and PictoBlox shows the protection message.
widgets.question: The camera sees this leaf:

options.label: Neem leaf (toothed small leaflets)
options.result: This is a NEEM tree. It gives shade, clean air and medicine. Protect it!
options.te: ఇది వేప చెట్టు. నీడ, మంచి గాలి, ఔషధం ఇస్తుంది. రక్షించండి!

options.label: Tamarind leaf (tiny leaflets)
options.result: This is a TAMARIND tree. It is also precious for our village.
options.te: ఇది చింత చెట్టు. ఇది కూడా విలువైనది.

options.label: Fresh cut stump
options.result: A tree has been cut! Note the place and time and tell the Panchayat secretary or forest office.
options.te: చెట్టు నరికారు! పంచాయతీ కార్యదర్శి లేదా అటవీ శాఖకు చెప్పండి.
options.tip: Don't argue with the people cutting. Stay safe and tell elders.

items.title: Permission needed
items.text: In Telangana, cutting trees needs permission from officials under the WALTA Act.
items.te: తెలంగాణలో వాల్టా చట్టం ప్రకారం చెట్లు నరకడానికి అనుమతి అవసరం.

items.title: Common land belongs to all
items.text: Trees on village common land belong to the whole village, not to one person.

items.title: Report it
items.text: Tell the Panchayat secretary or the forest office if you see illegal cutting.

items.title: Plant more
items.text: For every tree, plant and care for new saplings.

questions.q: What should you do if you see someone cutting trees at night?
options: Stay safe and tell the Panchayat or forest office
questions.why: Your safety comes first. Officials can take action.

questions.q: Which is a gift of the neem tree?
questions.why: Neem gives shade, cleaner air, and is used in traditional medicine.

how: Collect leaves of neem, tamarind and other village trees.
In Teachable Machine (Image Project), make one class per leaf and take 50 photos of each.
Train, Export and copy the model link.
In PictoBlox, load the model and show the tree's name and a protection rule.
Ask Gemini to explain tree protection rules in simple words, and check them with your teacher.
Show the project at a Gram Sabha meeting.
prompt: I am a Class 8 student in Telangana. Explain in simple English and Telugu why old neem trees are important for a village and what villagers can do to stop illegal tree cutting on common land.
